# E0359: a move reads a source field whose values the target field does not all accept

A move takes a source field's value as it is, so the target field must
accept every value the source field may hold. Here count may be any integer,
and total accepts only non-negative ones.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	count: int
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	total: int & >=0
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		total: v0_0.count
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	total: int & >=0
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0359]: the ForwardLens in history/1.0.thema moves v0_0.count into total, which does not accept every value of it
 --> history/1.0.thema:8:10
  |
8 |         total: v0_0.count
  |                ^^^^
  |
  = note: total in 1.0 is now uint, which does not accept every value of the prior int (moving v0_0.count; compatibility rule value-narrowed)
  = help: map total from a value it accepts: a _match, or a computed value
```
